newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil July 24-Aug 23 Fipe inflation at 0.63 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil July 24-Aug 23 Fipe inflation at 0.63 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.63 percent in the July 24-August 23 period, down from 0.83 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of Fipe, said a 2.14 percent decline in clothing prices helped slow down the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo at weekly intervals.
Rizzieri said Fipe forecasts a 0.50 percent rise in the index for the entire month of August.
He also gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food 0.38 pct rise in the period
- Housing 2.06 pct rise in the period
- Transportation 0.22 pct rise in the period
- Personal expenses 0.10 pct rise in the period
- Clothing -2.14 pct fall in the period
- Health care 2.62 pct rise in the period
- Education 0.17 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo.
